claims: The Philadelphia Phillies open the 2026 MLB season at home against the Texas Rangers on Thursday, March 26, 2026, at 3:05 p.m. ET at Citizens Bank Park.
Justin Crawford and Andrew Painter made the Philadelphia Phillies' 2026 Opening Day roster.
NBC Sports Philadelphia reported that Justin Crawford is set to start in center field.
The Philadelphia Phillies' 26-man roster includes 11 players not on the 2025 opening roster, according to MLB.com.
The New York Times reported that Orion Kerkering will start on the injured list with a hamstring strain.
The Philadelphia Phillies signed Oscar Mercado to a minor-league contract, as reported by Sports Illustrated.
The Desert Sun notes that the Phillies play 13 games on March 26 for a traditional start.
The 2026 All-Star Game will be hosted in Philadelphia on July 14, according to The News Journal.
